desc:
🏈 3D FOOTBALL (3FB) 🏈
8v8 football you can actually play. Call it in the huddle, beat the play clock, and go score.

🎮 MODES
• Quick Game: hop right into a game vs the CPU
• Online 1v1: play real people and build your W-L record 🔥
• Career: run your own franchise and chase a title 🏆
• Road to Pro: make one player and take him all the way to the top
• Practice: WR vs DB reps to sharpen your routes and coverage

🏟️ ON THE FIELD
Pick from a real playbook, juke, stiff arm, truck people, lay the hit stick, or jump the route for a pick. Rain games leave puddles on the field, so watch your footing 🌧️ 

👕 YOUR LOOK
Helmets, visors, facemasks, cleats, gloves, sleeves, eye black, hair, tattoos and a lot more. Every game pays coins, spend them in the shop.

📅 New daily challenges every day.
📱💻🎮 Works on phone, PC and controller.

Like 👍 and favorite ⭐ for more updates!
